name: kmeans

comment: Sig: [idx, C, sumd, D] = kmeans(X, K, 'MaxIter'/'Replicates'/'Distance'/'Start'/'Display'/'EmptyAction', val, ...). Default Distance='sqeuclidean', Start='plus'.
